purpose: Machine-readable ratified-rename source. Closes B5: a rename cannot rely on a model reading prose. A generated artifact that requires a deprecated term in founder-facing intent text is a defect, detected deterministically — never by asking a model whether the wording 'seems current'.
authority: Founder ratification, including 2026-08-17 instruction that Taloa is the current product name and Lumin is historical lineage only unless required by a live compatibility contract.

enforcement.scope_note: Only prose scopes are checked automatically. Code identifiers, paths, env vars, database names, receipt ids, mission ids, hashes, and compatibility aliases require governed migration rather than blind replacement.

terms.note: Current product identity is Taloa. Historical records may retain Lumin when describing prior state or explaining how/why the system changed. Live identifiers are not blindly renamed: each must be classified as current prose, compatibility surface, historical evidence, or governed code/schema migration before change.
terms.historical_exception: Allowed only when explicitly labeled as historical/former naming or when preserving an existing technical contract until a governed migration replaces it.

terms.note: The constitutional office. OPEN-6 resolved 2026-08-11: the office keeps this name; the unrelated session-supervisor role that also used 'Conductor' is renamed instead.

collisions.as_is_reality: Physical names conductor_session_savings and conductor_builder_audit remain in the live schema. services/savings-ledger.js exports sessionSupervisorSession with an intentional conductorSession alias so no caller breaks.
collisions.migration_bridge: Renaming a live table requires a governed migration and coordinated deploy, so it is deliberately NOT done as a side effect of a naming fix. data/terminology-collision-baseline.json pins the 19 as-is occurrences and scripts/verify-terminology-collisions.mjs fails builder:preflight on any NEW one, so silence cannot make them permanent.
